title: Enforcement case record
description: One violation category from one official enforcement notice. Column order in enforcement_cases.csv must match the property order below — scripts/validate.py enforces it.

violation_category.description: the violation as worded in the notice, condensed

app_count.description: number of apps cited under this category. LEAVE BLANK when the notice states a problem type without a count — CONTRIBUTING says do not guess. A blank here is a fact about the source, not a missing value.

example_apps.description: apps named in the notice body, semicolon separated

legal_basis.description: instruments cited by the notice, semicolon separated

evidence_quote.description: verbatim quote from the archived notice
